name: bo6
title: Call of Duty: Black Ops 6 (multiplayer and zombies, cod24)
note: Phase 1 (container, working set, exe): no tables yet. Exe: the decrypted cod24-cod.exe (same PE timestamp 1783954360 as the install's), flattened (file offset == RVA). The campaign (sp24, its own exe and zone names shared with cod24) is left for a profile of its own.
install_note: Plain Steam files (no CASC): cod24\*.ff (10 013, 9 649 of them _tr) with 11 .fp update patches beside them, streamed data in .xsub packages (cod24 and the install root's codhq24_shared-*). Container: Games/IW/Container25.cpp (shared with Black Ops 7) (IWffa100 0x19).
args_note: every loader and primitive takes the load context in rcx: file_read(ctx, dst, n), Load_Stream(ctx, bool atStreamStart, dst, n), Load_String(ctx, char **), the context's push(ctx, block) and alloc(ctx, align)
rva_note: ReadXFile(ctx, dst, n); Load_Stream(ctx, read, dst, n): reads unless block 11 (memset), the position ctx+0x108 advanced (+0x608 for block 15 when ctx+0x5f4); Load_String 0x29f69d0 a byte at a time; alloc/push/pop the context's methods (vtable 0x95d6d68 +0/+8/+0x10); load_string_ptr 0x29f6aa0(ctx, char **): a name-only reference's name, a byte at a time, then hashed (the alloc(0) and DB link around it)

stream.markers_note: draft: phase 2 settles the markers (a pointer & 0x7fffffffffffffff equal to 0x7fffffffffffffff inline, 0x3fffffffffffffff a name-only reference; the asset list's slots -1 or 0x7000000000000000)
stream.stream_objects_note: LoadStreamFuncPointers (vtable slot 0xa7088f0, functor 0xa7088f8): the readers' own read for atStreamStart, set by 0x29f5f30 to Load_Stream
stream.machinery_note: the function object assignment and the stream state init 0x29f5f30 calls; Load_AssetType (the hash mapped in place) and Load_AssetHeader (the type switch: its je targets are the loaders, which the reach rule does not follow); the Load_Stream functor class (vtable 0xa718b08: invoke, copy, move, destroy), what the function object calls; 0x2818530 (the Load_Stream function object called with its arguments by value) and 0x2818570 (alloc with the alignment plus one), which the weapon loader 0x287d8e0 calls: the reach rule skipped them and the weapon read nothing
stream.null_page_note: engine lookups the dump leaves empty return null and the loader reads through it (MWIII AllocateUniqueString 0x3d41bd0 skipped; BO7 Load_CustomScriptString 0x3ad7730 falls back to address 8 when the script string map has no entry): a zero page reads as an empty result
stream.read_calls_note: Load_CustomScriptString(ctx, u32 *): the high u32 of the script string hash read by file_read into a local, the index looked up in the zone's map
stream.stream_object_calls_note: 0x2818530(that, ctx, bool flag, dst, n on the stack): the function object called with its arguments by value (weapon 0x287d90a); 0x2818570 (alloc with the alignment plus one) is recognised as an alloc wrapper
stream.keyed_refs_note: A pointer is inline when bit 61 is set; unless bit 62 is set too the loader files the data it reads under the key value & 0x1fffffffffffffff (ResolveStreamPositionEx 0x29f5df0, a hash map at the zone memory's 0x14d90); a non-null pointer without bit 61 is a reference by that key (ResolveStreamPosition 0x29f5fd0). An asset pointer (Ptr loader) is -1 / 0x7fff... inline, 0x3fff... name only (the name follows, hashed), else the referenced asset's name hash (LinkGenericXAssetEx 0x29a7ea0, value & 0x7fff...): no stream layout, no back reference by block and offset

stream_init_call.note: DB_InitLoadStreams(ctx, zone): the stream state over the zone memory's 16 blocks (0x29b0840), Load_Stream installed in the function object

memory_objects.note: the rewind table ResolveStreamPosition (0x29f5fd0) looks back references up in: hashedRefs at 0x38, bucket count at 0x40; empty
the script string map Load_ScriptStringCustom (0x29f70f0) looks u64 hashes up in; empty, a lookup finds nothing and the slot reads 0 (stream.null_page)

asset_type_map.note: GetMappedXAssetType: FNV-1a 32 of the type name -> pool id

asset_dispatch.note: Load_XAsset(ctx, 0, &entry): the hash mapped (0x29923e0), the switch 0x2888a30 to the type's Ptr loader

zone_load.note: ParseFastFile 0x29f6450: file_read of the 0x30 list, push(15), DB_LoadStringList, DB_LoadUnkList (count u32 read when its pointer is set), pop, push(15), the array alloc(7) and read, Load_XAsset per entry

transcriber_budget_note: a reader whose symbolic run passes 200 000 instructions is refused (the table generation once took over 10 minutes on a handful of them)
